2/1/2001 Editors Corner - Ethan Burrow, Prince of Austin

OK, so I skipped last month. I was having a busy month and something
had to give. On a side note, and I don't want to jump the gun without
confirming it...but hopefully there will be a surprise next week.
You'll know it when you see it. And if things don't go to plan, I'll
cry myself to sleep in the corner.

BTW, we hope to have tournaments slated for March and July in Dallas.
While we don't have confirmed dates, if you want to tickle Mike Ooi you
should probably keep the weekends of those months open just in case.
Don't worry, we'll announce when we know for sure.

Oh, and the Assamites suck. Reap it Derek Ray!

-----------------------------------------------------------------------

Vampire of the Month - Greta Kircher

The third new vampire our clan received in the Sabbat War expansion,
Greta's special ability makes her unique in the game and gives our clan
a major boost. Another 7 capacity vampire with all three in-clan
superiors is a definite boost for the clan. Plus the discipline
obfuscate, the first vampire in our clan to receive this skill. She can
surprisingly enough fit in well with Setites (who could use the bleed
defense), but otherwise this skill will probably not be used with other
members of our clan for some time.

Her special ability warrants special attention. She can reduce each
bleed by one, and she doesn't have to be ready or untapped to do it.
This is huge. Couple that with Telepathic Counter and you can reduce
bleeds by 3. Give her ways to gain extra blood such as The Rack, Blood
of the Sabbat, Aaron's Feeding Razor, Hungry Coyote, Palatial Estate,
etc. and you can really shutdown small bleed decks and even hold off
weenie swarms if you can continue to refill Greta every turn.

-----------------------------------------------------------------------

Card of the Month - Telepathic Misdirection

When you hear of bleed defense, you immediately think of Dominate
(Deflection/Redirection). While dominate is able to bounce at inferior,
I still think Telepathic Misdirection is the superior card.

At inferior you get intercept. Sure you pay a blood for it, but casual
intercept can go a long way.

At superior it bounces bleeds. It does tap you, but aside from dominate
this is one of the only other bleed bounce cards. With bleed bounce
being so important to tournament survival, you either play with
dominate or you play with this card or it's cheaper and weaker cousin
My Enemy's Enemy.

This card has so many defensive capabilities that it will never jam
your hand. If you aren't being bled you can still use it to intercept.
Consequently you can also still use this card once you reach a two
player game. The versatility of this card far outweighs it's blood
cost.

-----------------------------------------------------------------------

Homework Assignments - an exercise in creative deckbuilding

For the past couple of years, we've been daring each other to make
certain decks. We'd pick a card we assumed useless, and then task a
person to actually build a deck using that card. Most often, the
results were surprising...as the card we once thought sucked finally
became useful. Other times, it actually becomes a catalyst for a
further refined deck idea that performs real well.

Previous (but not all) Homework assignments for Austin players :

Build a deck that uses Regeneration.
Build a deck that uses Soul Stealing.
Build a deck around Imogen using all of her disciplines.
Build a deck with Twisting the Knife.
Build a Malkavian-Antitribu Rush deck.

You get the idea.

Well, since it's become so popular in Austin (i.e. people continually
ask me for a homework assignment), I figured I'll make it a regular
installment in the newsletter so that r.g.t-c.j can join in. Anyone is
welcome to submit their decks to me resulting from the assignment. I
will pick the best deck based on my personal opinion using innovation,
success in games, fun, and theme accuracy. The winning deck will be
posted in the next newsletter, in addition to the owner of the deck
gaining the respect of the Austin Coterie (and who knows what other
boon in the future <g>).

This month's homework assignment - Due February 28th, 2001

Construct a deck using Violet Tremain. The deck *must* utilize all of
her disciplines. Good Luck!
